title: ShieldCare Attendance Charge Share Schedule
content:
## Shares of the attendance charges booked

An attendance charge booked against the job on a covered item is met by a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection
Plan only where the plan carries attendance at the address, and the share then turns on whether an included
visit stands drawn on that job in the records of Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair inside the last
12 months.

| What the records show | The share of the attendance charges booked the plan meets |
| --- | --- |
| every other plan | none of the attendance charges booked |
| the plan carries attendance at the address, and an included visit stands drawn on the job inside the last 12 months | 60 percent of them |
| the plan carries attendance at the address, and no included visit stands drawn on the job inside that time | the whole of the attendance charges booked, being 100 percent |

## Points of judgement

A plan that does not carry attendance at the address meets none of the attendance charges, however many or
few visits stand drawn on the job. Where the plan does carry attendance, a single drawn visit inside the last
12 months is enough to bring the share from the whole of the charges down to 60 percent; a visit drawn 13
months ago is outside that time and leaves the whole of the charges met.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

With attendance charges of 220.00 booked in the window read on a plan that does not carry attendance at the
address, the attendance met is nothing and the 220.00 stays with the customer. On a plan that does carry
attendance at the address, the attendance met is 132.00 where one visit stands drawn inside the last 12
months, and 220.00 where none does.
